Manx: ta mee er clashtyn jeh chenn dooiney as y ven va baghey ayns thie ayns y valley
English: i have heard of an old man and his woman wife living in a house in the village

Manx: as un oie va ny guillyn goll mygeayrt dy yeeaghyn son red ennagh dy yannoo
English: and one night the boys were going about looking for something to do

Manx: as ren ad coodagh yn uinnag seose lesh soddyn
English: and they did cover the window up with sods his window

Manx: er y voghree ren yn dooiney girree dy yeeaghyn row sollys cheet
English: on the morning the old man did arise to see was light coming

Manx: cha ren eh fakin red erbee agh dorraghys as hie eh dy lhie reesht
English: he did not see anything but darkness and he went to sleep again

Manx: traa lurg shen ren eh gaase gaccrys as dirree as hie eh gys y dorrys
English: a time after that he did grow hungry and arose and he went to the door

Manx: ren eh fakin yn eayst yn grian goll seose goll sheese ec kione bradda
English: and he did see the moon - the sun going up - going down at bradda head

Manx: haink eh back reesht gys y ven as dooyrt eh
English: he came back again to the woman and he said

Manx: my yee paaie ta'n seihll cheet dys jerrey ta'n grian girree ayns y sheear'
English: my god peggy the world is coming to an end the sun is rising in the west'
